login_hero.description: Industrial factory warehouse image for login page background

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'IBM Plex Sans' from Google Fonts for all typography to match the industrial and authoritative design archetype.
Implement the layout with a fixed dark navy sidebar (bg-slate-900) and a light main content area (bg-slate-50).
The login page must use the provided login_hero image as a full-screen background with the slate-900/60 overlay to ensure the white login card remains highly legible.
Ensure the status badges precisely use the mapped colors. These badges are critical for the factory workers to quickly identify the state of a part.
For the Line/Area selection cards, use large Lucide icons (mapped in the icons section), centered in a white rounded card with a hover effect.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for layouts and basic cards, but rely on shadcn/ui (if available) for complex components like Dialogs, Tabs, and Selects, styling them to match the guidelines.
ALL interactive elements and key informational areas MUST include data-testid attributes for testing.
Ensure the horizontal timeline on the dashboard is scrollable on smaller screens and clearly indicates the current stage of the process.
